title: Coffee shop order
genre: everyday spoken American English, a short real-life listening scene
setting: a busy neighborhood coffee shop at mid-morning
mood: warm, casual, slightly rushed but friendly
bed: Throughout: low café murmur, a distant espresso machine hissing in short bursts, ceramic cups clinking on the bar, faint indie music under the voices. Keep the dialogue clearly in the foreground.

speakers.name: Barista
speakers.voice: young woman, American, bright friendly barista voice, medium-fast, smiling

speakers.name: Alex
speakers.voice: young man, American, easygoing, a little hesitant, medium pace

beats.speaker: Barista
beats.direction: calling out from behind the bar
beats.text: Hey, welcome in! What can I get for you today?
A short pause — espresso steam hisses, then settles.

beats.speaker: Alex
beats.text: I'll take a medium oat milk latte, please. And, uh, could you add an extra shot?
The barista scribbles on a cup with a marker.

beats.speaker: Barista
beats.text: Medium oat milk latte, extra shot. You got it! Anything else? Maybe a pastry or somethin'?

beats.speaker: Alex
beats.text: Oh, actually yeah — you guys still have those blueberry muffins?

beats.speaker: Barista
beats.text: We sure do! Just came out of the oven like twenty minutes ago. You want one?

beats.speaker: Alex
beats.text: Yeah, toss one in. That's it for me.

beats.speaker: Barista
beats.text: Alright, so that's a medium oat latte with an extra shot, and a blueberry muffin. That'll be eight seventy-five. Name for the order?

beats.speaker: Alex
beats.text: It's Alex. Here you go — tap.
Alex taps a card on the reader — a short electronic beep.

beats.speaker: Barista
beats.text: Awesome, Alex! Should be ready in just a few minutes. Have a good one!

closing: The café murmur carries the scene out as the ticket printer chatters.
question: What does Alex order?

options.label: A medium oat latte with an extra shot and a muffin
A large black coffee and a blueberry scone
A medium cappuccino with an extra shot
An oat latte and two blueberry muffins
